item.title: Show HN: ssh paint.dn.ht
item.summary: Hi all! I've been experimenting with making silly little GUI apps for the terminal. Most TUIs just use text mode but I thought it'd be fun to use features from modern terminals like Ghostty, iTerm2 and kitty that let you draw images and track the mouse position in pixels. Unfortunately, this demo doesn't work well in all terminals or in multiplexers like tmux, sorry! Anyway, have fun! For some more fun, try this: ssh ski.dn.ht :-) Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49152322 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
